listing.name: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror — kirby-amazing-mirror-recomp (Felipe-Gomes-Amorim)
listing.summary: Upstream’s reported test covers only the first area and 8,000 frames. Deeper levels, bosses and abilities remain untested, and timing is approximate. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA B8KE Kirby: The Amazing Mirror ROM. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s compiler/runtime ZIP instructions to import your own ROM. The first game session uses an interpreter while compilation runs in the background; the next launch uses compiled code. Online play always uses the interpreter. Portcove does not install or prepare this project automatically.
